notes.title: Quality of life Update in Hello Engineer is here!
notes.content:
[h2]🛠️ Greetings, ingenious builders! Prepare your wrenches, it's tool-time for Hello Engineer! 🛠️[/h2]

Get ready to dive into some serious mechanical madness with the Quality of life Update rolling your way! 🔥Now, let's dive into the nuts and bolts of what's new with our Steamy Update!

[quote][h3][b]Highlights:[/b][/h3]

🚀 Aerodynamic overhaul: We've given your creations wings (well, kind of)! Now you can take to the skies with the board part, no engines needed! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/alSY8yf.gif[/img]

⚙️ Snap-tastic Gameplay Changes: We've revamped our snap and connect features, and boy, is it a game-changer! Snap your details, move & attach them wherever you need easily since they now keep the original postion. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMAkavo.gif[/img]

[/quote]

[quote][b]Full Patch Notes[/b] 
[b]Hello Engineer - Quality of Life Update [/b]

[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] 💨 Aerodynamic: Add wings to your contraptions and let your imagination take flight.[/list]
[b]Core improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] 🔗 Snap/Connect Features Change: the details now attach keeping their original postion. 
[*] 🌟 Unlimited Resources in Sandbox Mode: We're feeling generous! Enjoy infinite resources and all construction components in Sandbox mode. 
[/list]
[b]Other: [/b]
[list]
[*] 🌐 Display Mass Center: Need to balance your contraption? We've got you covered! We're now displaying the position of the mass center to help you fine-tune your creations.
[*] 🎯 Display Center of Long Parts: Precision engineering at its finest! See the center of those long parts.
[*] 🚙Car no longer can be edited on level 1.
[*] 🛠️ Various bug fixes and small improvements.
[/list][/quote]

notes.title: From scraps to donut cars: Hello Engineer is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, our fellow designers![/h3]

The gears are greased, the widgets are whirring, and the blueprints are freshly printed because Hello Engineer is here!

[h3]Welcome to the new vehicle construction game, where the only limit is your imagination![/h3]

Watch the trailer:

[previewyoutube=m82In9Jgi_k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🔧 Build Crazy Contraptions[/h3] 
Construct awesome vehicles from nothing but scraps, and challenge the eerie Neighbor. Whether you're rolling, flying, or bouncing, if your contraption gets the job done, consider it an engineering masterpiece! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/04UKiDJ.gif[/img]

[h3]👷 Solo or Squad[/h3] 
Whether you're a lone wolf engineer or prefer to tackle nutty challenges with pals, Hello Engineer has got you covered! Team up with up to 4 fellow engineers or build your own chaos in a campaign mode. 

[h3]🏞️ Build the machine of your wildest dreams with almost unlimited resources in sandbox mode. [/h3] 
Once you collect all the parts, you can build anything that hits your mind: cat mobile to your favorite movie car! When you finish your ingenious invention, check how it gets along with the environment and show it to your friends. You can also share the blueprints with your squad to expand the car collection!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zppN8By.gif[/img]

Following the tradition, we can't leave you without a giveaway to celebrate the launch! Join our Steam stream around 9:00 PT to try your luck and snag yourself a Hello Engineer key!

Get ready to crank up the chaos and let the inventive insanity begin. Welcome to Hello Engineer! 🛠️

See you at the park,
tinyIra, tinyBuild, Hologryph & Eerie Guest Studios

notes.title: ⚙️Hello Engineer Demo is back! Release date announcement!
notes.content:
[h3]Attention, Inventors Extraordinaire![/h3]

It's time to flex those creative muscles and dive headfirst into the incredible world of Hello Engineer. Introducing [b]the Hello Engineer Demo - back[/b], tuned with one additional chapter, and available for playing for a limited time! 

[h3]Wait a minute, some amazing news has just dropped like a ton of wrenches – [b]Hello Engineer's Full Launch is roaring in on August 17th![/b] Check out the trailer:[/h3]

https://youtu.be/DNwxrxs-sb4

To celebrate we're going to to put that pedal to the metal and launch mind-blowing discounts. Snag yourself Hello Engineer on Steam [b]with a 35 % discount during the whole week after the release[/b] & [b]stackable 15 % [/b] if you already own one of the these titles: Hello Neighbor, Hello Neighbor 2, Hello Neighbor: Hide and Seek, Hello Neighbor: Search and Rescue VR, or Secret Neighbor!

We know it's hard to wait for all of that but lighten up: we have something to do in the meantime! Let's see what the Demo is about, shall we?

[h3]📽️For full immersion into the plot and mastering the basics, we recommend the story mode.[/h3] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1xSEveK.png[/img]

Here you'll find yourself trapped in the legendary Golden Amusement, with the help of your notorious Neighbor, also known as Mr. Peterson. Assemble unbelievably shaped and configured vehicles to break free & beat the levels and conquer your creepy Neighbor. 

 [h3]🧰 ⚒️Now, after fully preparing for the real challenge, we invite you to a sandbox mode to take your scavenging and crafting skills to new heights. [/h3]

You now have almost unlimited resources and treasures like wooden planks, metal pipes, scrawny wheels, and dynamite! Invent awe-inspiring constructions to conquer the landscape & unlock hidden pathways to hard-to-reach places. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y1o0qv9.gif[/img]

Remember to gather your pals from the Neighborhood Rescue Squad to join the fun and create engineering marvels together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856190/Hello_Engineer/

Make sure that you have Hello Engineer on your wishlist, and grab the full game with an enormous discount on the launch day! If you liked the Demo, please feel free to [url=http://discord.gg/neighborgames][b]join our Discord server[/b][/url]. We have dedicated channels just for feedback, and we’d love to hear what you think!

Meet you on August 17th!

Cheers,
tinyIra, tinyBuild, Hologryph & Eerie Guest Studios

notes.title: Moustaches & Mysteries - Hello Neighbor 2 is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EEDpbLg.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr][h3]Ready your cameras and prepare to begin your investigation![/h3]

[h2]Hello Neighbor 2 is Available Now![/h2]

It's time to renew your investigation and return to the sleepy little town with a [i]bit[/i] of a missing person problem and a [b]whole[/b] a lot of mystery. Can you get to the bottom of what's really going on in Raven Brooks? Dive deeper into the town's dark secrets and uncover new sides to the story of how Mr. Peterson became "The Neighbor." 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321680/Hello_Neighbor_2/
[hr][/hr]
[h3][u]Attend the exclusive advance viewing of Welcome to Raven Brooks[/u][/h3]

Want to see Hello Neighbor Animated Series: Welcome to Raven Brooks before anyone else? Simply start up your last Hello Neighbor 2 save! Yes, you heard that right, we are [i]literally[/i] throwing the exclusive premiere of Welcome To Raven Brooks, [u][b]from inside[/b] Raven brooks! [/u]

So when you come across a strange television set with a countdown timer on it, go ahead and grab some popcorn and snacks before the big show! And if you missed the initial showing don't worry!

[u][h3][url=https://youtu.be/z0MZRMp0nxA][b]You can catch the replay on our YouTube channel Dec 11th at 10:00AM PT![/b][/url][/h3][/u]
[quote][h2]Game Editions[/h2]
[h3]Hello Neighbor 2: Deluxe Edition[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/8abd7c0d41bd40ed5d232fb8d78a873c0ce9037f.png[/img]
[h3]Level up your investigative tools, meet new Neighbors, & explore new locations + puzzles with the Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edtion! [/h3]

[b]The Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edition includes 3 day-one DLC:[/b]

📚 [b]Late Fees[/b]- Will you uncover something sinister in the endless maze of books that is the Raven Brooks Library? Only one way to find out!

🏫 [b]Back To School[/b] - Investigate the sprawling Raven Brooks Middle School for clues. But beware the creepy janitor and his fiendish 4-legged friends!

🚁 [b]Hello-copter[/b] - Surveil your Neighbors in style! This top-of-the-line gadget lets you spy on your suspects from safety and pilfer items with its retractable grappling claw!
[/quote]
[h2]Watch the launch day trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=RvUEaHljElg;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
Elevate your experience and increase your immersion with CORSAIR's iCUE technology. Synchronizing the RGB lighting on all your compatible CORSAIR devices gives you a setup-wide light show to go with your small-town-wide sneaking. 🔎

Before we sign off, I'd like to take a moment to say a big, heartfelt [b]thank you[/b] on behalf of the team to our amazing community of Neighbors near and far, both past and present! Thank you all for being right there with us playing through every new build, demo, and alpha over the past 5 years. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed developing it, and [u]please stay tuned for updates and post-launch news. [/u]

As always, we’ll see you in Raven Brooks.

Cheers!
